'''Perlica''' is a 5★ [[Electric]] [[Caster]] [[Operator]] from [[Endfield Industries]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''. She is an [[Arts Unit]] user who can effectively apply {{G|Electric Infliction|Electric Infliction}} and {{G|Electrification|Electrification}}, opening up combat opportunities for other operators in the team.

==Profile==
{{Quote|Only by walking upon the land, can we truly appreciate every breath and pulse of life....And this is what Endfield is fighting for.}}{{Quote|We once fought on and never gave up...for it is our wish to witness your return.}}
Perlica is the Supervisor of [[Endfield Industries]], a position she created. In this role, she oversees all company operations and serves as the official spokesperson. She is also a leading expert of Techno-Protocol and the development and application of [[Protocol-Originium]] technology, which makes her indispensible to the overall operations of the [[OMV Dijiang]]. Her past contributions include spearheading key research that enabled the adaptive use of this technology and assisting in the refinement of the [[Automated Industry Complex|Automated Industry Complex (AIC)]].

Perlica is characterized by her calm and decisive leadership during crises. While the [[Endministrator]] was in hibernation, she assumed command of the [[Crisis Team]], leading its personnel against significant threats. She travels extensively throughout the [[Civilization Band]] to maintain order and ensure the operational continuity of Endfield Industries.
